The '''GSS-5C Dustmaker''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A successor of the [[G-2A gunship]], which was known for razing whole [[City/Legends|cities]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], the Dustmaker was made to surpass its predecessor's firepower. While its defenses are a bit below the standard base line for [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] and was only able to equip a single [[Railgun/Legends|rail gun]], these weaknesses were curtailed with the ability to carry [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] and a heavier [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]].
